plan.title: BLOCKER: bug(update): seeded xBRIEF stamps require a two-pass compatibility migration

narratives.Description: A consumer that treats Deft version stamps in canonical xBRIEFs as compatibility pins cannot move from 0.112.0 to 0.113.x in one green PR. The accepted design is two independently green passes: Pass 1 consumer-only stamp deletion while 0.112.0 is installed; Pass 2 framework-only deft update from that cleaned tree. No shim, no canonical-xBRIEF exception, no third pass. Next-build is Bound-remedy on successor lean 5607103339, not the GitHub body. Recut: next-build contract is not this body.
narratives.Overview: History only. Next-build is Bound-remedy on successor lean 5607103339. Setup seeded DeftVersion stamps in canonical xBRIEFs; deft update does not manage those files; stamp-aware checks then deadlock 0.112.0 to 0.113.x. Two independently green passes, no shim.
narratives.Labels: bug, ci-cd, agent-experience, Upgrade Blocker, area:installer, legacy-arced, design-critique:ingest-ready
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on 0.112.0, I want a two-pass upgrade that is green at each merge, so that I can delete seeded xBRIEF stamps then run a framework-only deft update without mixed-content or stale-stamp failures.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit the setup skill source file and the hygiene.ts installerManagedMatchers module so Pass 1 absence locks evaluate Markdown list or section units, USER.md-only rules stay, and Pass 2 commit-set is installerManagedMatchers not the frozen Go list. 2. Add tests and a post-publish two-pass fixture from a clean directory using only a tag-bound registry install; do not call rehearseNpmInstallAndRun. After pack edits run task packs:render and task packs:verify-drift. Verify absence locks, nested package.json version equality, and denylist coverage including or deferring vbrief peers.
